title: SPDX 3.1 Release Candidate 1 — JSON Schema and JSON-LD context
_comment: Attached by the owner in chat on 2026-10-03 (as schema.json and spdx-context.jsonld) during the SPDX 3 applicability analysis, bean sd5v. QUEUED, NOT INGESTED: the ingest rungs read documents, not machine-readable schemas, and 3.1 is a release candidate. These are what the proposal cat-harness/docs/proposals/spdx-3-applicability-2026-10-03.md §2 reads 3.1's classes from (functionalsafety_EvaluationResult, RequirementVerification, Requirement, DefinedProcess, Action, the relationship types). When 3.1 is final, the final files supersede these; until then they are the evidence for every 3.1 claim in that proposal, which is why they are held rather than cited.

source.capturedBy: owner (litlfred), attached to a Claude Code session

files.note: JSON Schema draft 2020-12, '$comment': 'This file was automatically generated by shacl2code. DO NOT MANUALLY MODIFY IT'. Requires '@context' to be the const 'https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v3.1-RC1/rdf/spdx-context.jsonld'. 774 $defs. NOT compared with the published copy: spdx.github.io is refused by this container's proxy (CONNECT 403, 2026-10-03).
The JSON-LD context the schema names; terms map to https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/<Profile>/<Term>. NOT compared with the published copy, for the same reason.
